name: Sidebar nav
blurb: A vertical list of sections, with collapsible groups.
mechanism: Links in a list, with each group in a `<details open>` so a section collapses with no script. The active item is marked with `aria-current="page"`, which is also what the styling hangs off - one source of truth instead of a class that can drift.
caveats: Wrap it in `<nav aria-label="Sections">`; several unnamed navs on one page are indistinguishable.
Styling from `aria-current` means a wrong attribute is a visible bug rather than a silent one - which is the point, but it does mean the server has to set it.
A long sidebar needs a skip link ahead of it, or keyboard users tab through every item to reach the content.
